findings.detail: The IMU saturated for a moment while armed. A few at touchdown are a firm landing; more than that in the air is vibration reaching the flight controller. Only armed time is counted, because the counter itself runs from boot.

High enough that position and altitude hold suffer. Check propellers, motor bearings and the controller mounting. It follows the throttle (correlation 1.00), which points at the propellers and motors rather than at how the flight controller is mounted.
